mapper.insert: INSERT INTO books ( book_id, book_name, author_name, category, publication_year, created_by, created_on ) VALUES ( #{bookId}, #{bookName}, #{authorName}, #{category}, #{publicationYear}, #{createdBy}, #{createdOn} )
mapper.select: SELECT book_id, book_name, author_name, category, publication_year, created_by, created_on, updated_by, updated_on, deleted_by, deleted_on FROM books WHERE deleted_on IS NULL ORDER BY book_id

SELECT book_id, book_name, author_name, category, publication_year, created_by, created_on, updated_by, updated_on, deleted_by, deleted_on FROM books WHERE deleted_on IS NULL AND ( CAST(book_id AS TEXT) = #{value} OR LOWER(book_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') OR LOWER(author_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') OR LOWER(category) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') OR CAST(publication_year AS TEXT) = #{value} ) ORDER BY book_id
mapper.update: UPDATE books SET book_name = #{bookName}, author_name = #{authorName}, category = #{category}, publication_year = #{publicationYear}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_on = #{updatedOn} WHERE book_id = #{bookId} AND deleted_on IS NULL
